instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Inside a modern office, the man in the grey patterned blazer (R2) on the left and the man in the light blue sweater (R1) on the right stand facing each other in profile. They shake hands with a slightly adjusted grip. The background is a large window showing a city street under cool, diffused daylight.
elements: R1 and R2 are the two handshake participants facing each other
R1 extends his hand into the handshake with R2 rather than being an onlooker
R2 extends his hand into the handshake with R1 rather than being an onlooker
R1 and R2 clasp each other's hands with an adjusted grip
the interaction takes place inside a modern office
